name: Easy Content Manager
author: Tushar Imran

sections.description:
Content Manager is a versatile plugin that allows you to create, edit, delete, and duplicate custom post types and custom fields directly from your WordPress dashboard. Whether you need to manage portfolios, team members, projects, recipes, jobs, clients, or listings, Content Manager provides an intuitive interface to streamline your content management process.

With Content Manager, you can easily define and organize your content structure, making it easier to manage complex websites. The plugin supports hierarchical post types, allowing you to create parentchild relationships between posts. Additionally, you can add up to 12 custom fields to your post types, such as images, emails, and more, to enhance the functionality and flexibility of your content.

Why Use Content Manager Plugin?

  • Content Manager is an essential tool for anyone looking to enhance their WordPress website’s content management capabilities. Here are some compelling reasons to choose Content Manager:

1. Efficient Custom Post Type Management:

  • Easily create, edit, delete, and duplicate custom post types.
  • Predefined presets for common post types like Portfolios, Team Members, Projects, Recipes, Jobs, Clients, and Listings save time and effort.

2. Advanced Custom Field Configuration:

  • Add up to 12 custom fields to your post types, including text, images, emails, and more.
  • Set field labels, names, and default values to streamline content creation.

3. Hierarchical Structure Support:

  • Organize content with parentchild relationships, ideal for complex websites with nested content.

4. UserFriendly Interface:

  • Intuitive and straightforward interface makes it easy for users of all skill levels to manage content.

5. Enhanced Content Organization:

  • Customize URL slugs for better SEO and readability.
  • Quickly duplicate post types and items to maintain consistency and save time.

6. Flexible Content Management:

  • Manage post items with ease—create, edit, delete, and duplicate items within custom post types.
  • Comprehensive field management options allow for precise control over content structure.

7. Time-Saving Features:

  • Duplicate post types and items to avoid repetitive tasks.
  • Default values for custom fields reduce the need for manual input.

8. Scalability:

  • Suitable for websites of all sizes, from small blogs to large enterprise sites.
  • Supports up to 12 custom fields per post type, accommodating diverse content needs.

9. SEO Optimization:

  • Customizable slugs and wellorganized content improve search engine visibility.

10. Community and Support:

  • Regular updates and a supportive community ensure the plugin remains reliable and uptodate.
  • Comprehensive documentation and support forums provide assistance when needed.

Content Manager is designed to simplify and enhance your WordPress content management experience, making it an invaluable tool for developers, content creators, and site administrators alike.

Features 🔥

  • Create Custom Post Types: Easily create new custom post types with a userfriendly interface.
  • Edit Custom Post Types: Modify existing custom post types to suit your needs.
  • Delete Custom Post Types: Remove custom post types that are no longer needed.
  • Duplicate Custom Post Types: Quickly duplicate custom post types to save time.
  • Add Custom Fields: Add up to 12 custom fields to your post types, including text, images, emails, and more.
  • Field Label and Name: Define field labels that appear on the edit page and field names for internal use.
  • Default Values: Set default values for fields that appear when creating a new post.
  • Create Post Items: Add new items to your custom post types.
  • Edit Post Items: Modify existing post items within your custom post types.
  • Delete Post Items: Remove post items that are no longer needed.
  • Duplicate Post Items: Quickly duplicate post items to save time.
  • Hierarchical Structure: Organize your content with hierarchical post types, allowing for parentchild relationships.
  • UserFriendly Interface: Simple and intuitive interface for managing your content.
  • Presets: Quick setup with predefined post type presets like Portfolio, Team Members, Projects, Recipes, Jobs, Clients, and Listings.
  • Slug Management: Customize the URL slug for each post type to improve SEO and readability.
  • Custom Field Management: Easily add, edit, duplicate, and delete custom fields with a straightforward interface.

1. How do I create a new post type?

Go to the Content Manager section in your WordPress dashboard, click on “Add Post Type,” and fill in the required fields such as Singular Name, Plural Name, and Slug. You can also choose from predefined presets to speed up the process.

2. Can I add custom fields to my post types?

Yes, you can add up to 12 custom fields such as text, images, emails, and more to your post types using the Custom Fields section. Simply click on “Add” and define the label, name, and type for each field.

3. What is a hierarchical post type?

A hierarchical post type allows you to create parentchild relationships between posts. This is useful for organizing content that has a natural hierarchy, such as chapters in a book or categories in a portfolio.

4. Can I edit or delete custom fields?

Yes, you can edit, duplicate, or delete custom fields from the Custom Fields management interface. Each field has options to modify or remove it as needed.

5. How do I duplicate a post type or post item?

To duplicate a post type or post item, simply navigate to the respective section in the Content Manager and click on the “Duplicate” option. This will create a copy of the selected post type or item.

6.What are field labels and names?

Field labels are the names that appear on the edit page, while field names are used internally and should be single words with no spaces (underscores and dashes are allowed).

7.Can I set default values for custom fields?

Yes, you can set default values for custom fields that will appear when creating a new post.
